actionPending.message: Another ride action is still running.

actionUnavailable.message: This action isn't available right now.
actionUnavailable.nextStep: Check the current ride, then try again.

gpsRequired.message: This distance source needs GPS recording.
gpsRequired.nextStep: Turn on GPS route, or choose another distance source in Settings.

healthDenied.message: Power Log can't save to Health.
healthDenied.nextStep: Allow it in the Health app, then start again.

healthLocked.message: Health data is unavailable while this device is locked.

healthUnavailable.message: Health isn't available on this device.
healthUnavailable.nextStep: Turn off Save to Health, then start again.

locationDenied.message: Power Log can't use your location.
locationDenied.nextStep: Allow location in Settings, or turn off GPS for this ride.

ownerForeign.message: Another browser tab is recording this ride.
ownerForeign.nextStep: Use that tab to control it.

rideActive.message: A ride is already in progress.
rideActive.nextStep: Finish or discard it before starting another.

rideChanged.nextStep: Check the current ride, then try again.

settingsUnreadable.message: Power Log couldn't read your saved settings.
settingsUnreadable.nextStep: Open Settings on your iPhone and reset them, then start again.

startCancelled.message: This start was cancelled before the ride began.

startExpired.message: This start arrived too late to begin the ride.

startUnconfirmed.message: Power Log couldn't confirm the start.

storageBusy.message: Power Log is busy saving your ride.

storageFailed.message: Power Log couldn't save this change.
storageFailed.nextStep: Try again. Your recorded data is kept.

storageFull.message: This device is out of storage.
storageFull.nextStep: Free up space, then try again.

uiUnavailable.message: Power Log couldn't open this screen.
uiUnavailable.nextStep: Open Power Log, then try again.

unknown.nextStep: Try again. Your recorded data is kept.

watchBusy.message: Your Apple Watch is still busy with another ride.
watchBusy.nextStep: Finish or discard it on your Apple Watch, then start again.

watchLaunchFailed.message: Power Log couldn't open on your Apple Watch.
watchLaunchFailed.nextStep: Unlock your Apple Watch and keep it near your iPhone, then start again.

watchMessageInvalid.message: Your Apple Watch sent something Power Log couldn't read.
watchMessageInvalid.nextStep: Install the same Power Log build on your iPhone and Apple Watch.

watchNotInstalled.message: Power Log isn't installed on your Apple Watch.
watchNotInstalled.nextStep: Install it from the Watch app on your iPhone, or turn off Apple Watch in Settings.

watchStartUnconfirmed.message: Your Apple Watch didn't confirm the start.
watchStartUnconfirmed.nextStep: Open Power Log on your Apple Watch, keep it unlocked and nearby, then start again.

watchVersionMismatch.message: Power Log on your Apple Watch is a different version.
watchVersionMismatch.nextStep: Install the same Power Log build on your iPhone and Apple Watch, or turn off Apple Watch in Settings.

issues.phoneUnreachableAtStart: Open Power Log on your phone to start a ride.
issues.commandUnconfirmed: Your phone didn't confirm. Check Power Log on your phone, then try again.
issues.endedLocallyUnreachable: Your phone isn't reachable, so the ride ended on your Watch. Finish it on your phone.
issues.endedLocallyUnconfirmed: Your phone didn't confirm, so the ride ended on your Watch. Check it on your phone.
issues.orphanRecovered: Your last ride was interrupted. Finish or discard it on your phone.

reasons.sessionBusy: Apple Health is still finishing the last ride.
